## Vision
Make ControlPlane a **world-class macOS 26 (Tahoe)** menu-bar agent: the kind of app that could win an Apple Design Award — calm, private, accessible, deeply system-native, and delightful to configure.

This is a **new product track** after Wave 1 (#116, closed). Live tracker is GitHub Issues only.

## Product principles
1. **Public APIs first** — Shortcuts, App Intents, Focus, CoreWLAN, SMAppService. Gate private leftovers; never revive them.
2. **SwiftUI + Swift 6** — migrate deliberately. Coexist with ObjC; no big-bang rewrite.
3. **LSUIElement by default** until a slice decides otherwise.
4. **Trust surfaces** — TCC, Login Items, privileged helper, Diagnostics educate.
5. **Test every journey** — UITests for E2E; `ControlPlaneTests` for logic.
6. **Do not invent secrets** — Sparkle EdDSA (#136) is maintainer-only.

## Child epics
| Epic | Topic |
| :--- | :--- |
| #191 | Platform foundation — Swift 6 + SwiftUI coexistence |
| #192 | SwiftUI shell — Settings + status item |
| #194 | First-run, TCC, and trust UX |
| #193 | Accessibility and HIG excellence |
| #196 | Evidence, Rules, and Actions product redesign |
| #195 | End-to-end UITest journeys |
| #198 | Localization and Help world-class |
| #197 | Release and distribution polish |

## Start-here slices (agent-ready)
### Platform

content.text:
Filed the WWDC track and closed Wave 1.

**Baseline (from the deep pass):** ControlPlane is a strong ObjC `LSUIElement` agent — evidence → context → actions, SMAppService helper, Shortcuts/App Intents, good unit characterization. The gaps for an Apple Design Award are SwiftUI/Swift 6, first-run/TCC trust UX, deep a11y, product redesign of Evidence/Rules/Actions, and real E2E UITests (today: 3 quarantined smokes).

**Tracker**
- Closed [#116](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/116) as Wave 1 done
- Parent: [#190](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/190)
- 8 child epics: [#191](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/191)–[#198](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/198)
- 25 agent-ready slices: [#199](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/199)–[#223](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/223)
- Holds unchanged: [#136](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/136) Sparkle key, [#171](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/171) Actions ≥2026-10-08, [#149](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/149) XPC collapse later

**Start order**
1. [#199](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/199) coexistence spike (reopens the old MenuBarExtra NO-SHIP under this goal)
2. In parallel: [#202](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/202) UITest harness, then the journey matrix under [#195](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/195)
3. After spike: [#200](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/200) Swift 6, [#201](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/201) `AGENTS.md`, [#203](https://github.com/scottdensmore/ControlPlane/issues/203) SwiftUI General

Still not started: Help Book full i18n, remaining Settings panes, rule builder, Diagnostics redesign — those belong under the epics and can be filed as the first slices land.
Ok lets file evrything we find
I'll inventory what's already filed against the epic plans, then create every missing slice.
